Based on the team note, the answer is one of Irving Langmuir or Bernard Vonnegut, and I can't confirm which from memory or from any source I checked. I lean toward Bernard Vonnegut, since he was a GE colleague working on instrumentation at the time, but that is a weak basis. A patent database search for the title and Schaefer as inventor would settle it.
CONFIDENCE: 45
